_comment: Edit this file to switch API versions, add dependencies, or change the active mod. Run 'vs-workspace.ps1 status' to validate.

_notes.apiVersion: Must match a folder name under api\ â€” run 'vs-workspace.ps1 fetch-api <version>' to add one.
_notes.targetMod: Set to the folder name under mods\ that you want Claude Code to build/edit.
_notes.gameDirectory: Your Vintage Story install folder. Pre-filled into new mods' localSettings.props. Also accepts version-specific env vars (VINTAGE_STORY_1_21, etc.).
_notes.dependencies: List folder names under dependencies\ that Claude Code should read for context.
_notes.examples: List folder names under examples\ that Claude Code should study for patterns.
